capabilities: Turn list items into colored callouts by typing a trigger character or a tag
Color ==highlight== spans with callout colors and markers
Configure callout characters, icons, colors, and nested-item coloring
Cycle or remove callouts with Next/Previous/Remove commands
Register custom SVG icons from the vault's .obsidian/icons folder
extras: Fork uses a new plugin id, so settings from the original List Callouts do not carry over automatically; a settings-tab button copies them over and the old plugin should then be disabled or deleted. Custom icons are only read after Obsidian finishes starting up, requiring a restart or plugin toggle.
intentEvidence: This project is a fork of obsidian-list-callouts by @mgmeyers
motivation: The original plugin had seen no activity since September 2024 and appeared abandoned, so the author forked it to keep it working with current Obsidian versions.
problem: Obsidian's callouts only work as block quotes; there is no maintained way to give individual list items or highlighted text callout colors.

relations.evidence: This project is a fork of obsidian-list-callouts by @mgmeyers
This follows List Callouts Tags, without replacing character callouts
With Callout Manager enabled, the settings tab offers an Import from Callout Manager button
Callout padding and background intensity can be adjusted with the Style Settings plugin
This is the same folder Iconize uses, so a vault already keeping icons there needs no changes

summary: Fork of List Callouts that colors list items and ==highlights== as callouts, with custom icons, tag triggers, and cycling commands.
